messages:
Alex Kim: hey folks :wave: I'm Alex, started today on Platform Eng. Quick access questions: SSO keeps showing 'account not found' when I try to sign into Redwood SSO; my Mac shows an MDM error 'enrollment failed - profile already exists'; and I'm an agency contractor — do I need to enroll the device? Also saw a security training email. Who's best to ping to unblock these? Thanks!

Riley (People Ops): welcome Alex! :tada: Ping @sam-it (IT) for SSO/MDM — we handle contractor exceptions case-by-case. Did the recruiter mention if you’re on agency payroll or through a vendor?

Alex Kim: I'm with Nimbus (vendor). Recruiter said limited access but no details. SSO still fails even when I use the invite link.

sam-it: hey Alex — sam from IT. Can you DM me the exact error screenshot? 'Account not found' usually means your SAML app isn't assigned yet. Try logging into Okta: https://redwood.okta.com and see if the Redwood app is listed. If not, I'll trigger a reprovision. You can also run: `/okta-refresh` from the IT bot.

Alex Kim: sent screenshot in DM. Okta shows 'No applications assigned' under my account.

Jas (InfoSec): Re: phishing sims & training — agency contractors are generally included for the initial onboarding course and the phishsim program, unless the contract specifically excludes training. For MDM: we require enrollment for any device that accesses corp VPCs or secrets. There is a limited-exception form for read-only roles; @Riley can advise. :lock:

Priya (Eng Manager): hi Alex — we'll need you on GitHub and Slack ASAP. @sam-it can you prioritize SSO? We can provision a limited GitHub invite temporarily if needed, but prefer SSO-based access.

mdm-bot: MDM enrollment check: Hostname 'alex-mbp' shows prior MDM profile from 'NimbusMDM'. To remove old profile: System Settings > Profiles > remove 'NimbusMDM'. If macOS blocks GUI removal, run in terminal: `sudo profiles -P` to list profiles and `sudo profiles -R -p <profile-identifier>` to remove. Re-enroll after removal.

Alex Kim: removed old profile and re-enrolling now. One more: I got an email saying 'complete security training by EOD' but I'm a contractor — should I still complete it?

Riley (People Ops): yes please complete the initial security training — it's required for onboarding (even contractors). You won't be added to the recurring payroll training cadence, but the onboarding course + phishsim opt-in is required to get access. If the LMS denies you, ping me and I'll escalate.

Alex Kim: completed the course and confirmed the phishsim opt-in. Thanks all!

Jas (InfoSec): great, thanks Alex. Quick internal note: contractors requesting sensitive access also need a signed DPA/vendor-risk sign-off. @Riley — can you confirm if Nimbus' paperwork is on file?

Riley (People Ops): will check vendor docs and DM you, Jas. Alex — cc'ing @Priya on the access ticket, and will follow up once vendor checks are done. Welcome aboard!
